# SB-1028 Safety bulletin: quench oil fire risk

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01

## Hazard description
There is an elevated risk of quench oil ignition associated with the radial ring rolling mill quench system on EQ-P3-L4-RR01. Condition can arise when oil is entrained in the quench delivery or return plumbing and exposed to hot surfaces or sparking during normal operation or maintenance. Resulting fires propagate rapidly along piping and can compromise adjacent electrical panels and structural insulation. This bulletin summarizes immediate mitigations to reduce ignition potential and to align operations with established maintenance and operating procedures.

## Affected equipment
Primary affected equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01 (Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1). Lubricant and quench oil identification: CFW-LUB-315 is the lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01). Associated systems potentially at risk include localized quench delivery, oil return sumps, and surrounding service platforms on P3-L4.

## Required controls
- Isolate and de-energize electrical sources at the work area before any intervention on quench lines; verify isolation per SOP-P3-L4-01.  
- Drain and contain quench oil from exposed piping and sumps prior to hot work; capture and dispose in accordance with MM-P3-L4-RR01.  
- Inspect quench hose, fittings, and drip points for signs of abrasion, leakage, or pooling; tag out components that show evidence of permeation or steady seepage.  
- Prohibit storage of absorbent materials or combustible debris beneath quench lines and sumps; maintain clear access for emergency response.  
- Any hot work or welding near quench equipment requires a written permit and monitoring per SOP-P3-L4-04.  
- Report all leak events and near-miss ignition events to Maintenance and Safety for follow-up and trend analysis under MM-P3-L4-RR01.

## Effective date
Effective date: Immediate

Related documents: MM-P3-L4-RR01, SOP-P3-L4-01, SOP-P3-L4-04
